rules.name: Stalled Technical Round Follow-up
rules.description: Trigger when applicant in Technical Round 1 has had no scorecard or status update for > 48 hours.

rules.name: Offer Decision & Acceptance Check-in
rules.description: Trigger when an offer letter has been pending acceptance for > 72 hours without candidate reply.

rules.name: Screening Feedback Acceleration
rules.description: Trigger when a newly applied candidate remains unreviewed in Screening for > 24 hours.

rules.name: High-Value Account Outreach (EspoCRM)
rules.description: Trigger when a high-value sales account in evaluation phase has had no touchpoint for > 4 days.

suggestedTiming.rationale: Engineering leads demonstrate peak open rates on Tuesday mornings post-standup.
suggestedTiming.customizedMessage: Hi Priya, hope your week is off to a great start! Our engineering panel thoroughly enjoyed your Technical Round 1 discussion. We wanted to quickly touch base regarding the next steps and bar-raiser schedule.
